import math
# coordinates: O origin, r=1, C on x axis at distance d with BC=1, angle BCO=30 => B on circle
r=1
C=(2*math.cos(math.radians(30)),0)  # law: OC=2cos30 for OB=BC=1
d=C[0]
B=(d-math.cos(math.radians(30)),math.sin(math.radians(30)))
assert abs(math.hypot(*B)-1)<1e-9
assert abs(math.hypot(B[0]-C[0],B[1]-C[1])-1)<1e-9
# line AB through B and C meets circle again at A
dx,dy=B[0]-C[0],B[1]-C[1]
# param C+t*(dx,dy); |P|=1
a=dx*dx+dy*dy;b=2*(C[0]*dx+C[1]*dy);c=C[0]**2+C[1]**2-1
disc=math.sqrt(b*b-4*a*c)
ts=[(-b+disc)/(2*a),(-b-disc)/(2*a)]
ts.sort(key=lambda t:abs(t-1))
t=[t for t in ts if abs(t-1)>1e-6][0]
A=(C[0]+t*dx,C[1]+t*dy)
D=(-1,0)
u=(A[0],A[1]);v=D
ang=math.degrees(math.acos((u[0]*v[0]+u[1]*v[1])/math.hypot(*u)))
opts={'A':30,'B':90,'C':60,'D':80}
assert abs(ang-opts['B'])<1e-6
for k in 'ACD': assert abs(ang-opts[k])>1e-6
